b: Two deep listeners, Room 40 records boss English and Lancashire-born composer Skelton, find a still point in the midst of the storm of contemporary history on their new collaborative album

For two people standing on opposite sides of the planet, one’s midday becomes the other’s midnight. This first collaboration between British musician Richard Skelton and Australian composer Lawrence English hinges on the duality of this proposition: Skelton’s name written upside down beneath English’s, both pressed against the album cover’s featureless greyness, while the brightness of the palindrome NOON drowns in the supreme darkness of their music.
